## Overview

- Fix Adaptive Card `TextBlock` and `Fact` text so Markdown soft breaks (`\n`) render as visible
  line breaks in the in-app Canvas renderer and PDF export, matching the line breaks already
  produced by PowerPoint export.
- Decouple Desktop package data generation from the npm CLI runtime so Windows builds no longer
  depend on the state of the generated `packages/markdstage-cli/shared/` mirror.
- Keep the shared product version aligned at 4.2.8 across the Canvas Extension, Skill, npm CLI,
  and Desktop.

## Compatibility and migration

This patch release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. There are no breaking changes or new runtime requirements.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.8`. |
| Adaptive Cards | No action is required; multiline `TextBlock`/`Fact` text now renders line breaks consistently across Canvas, PDF, and PowerPoint output. |
| Desktop builds | No action is required; Desktop package data generation no longer requires a `shared/` mirror to be present or up to date. |
